ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of low-intensity black pixels (background surface) to high-intensity white/light-gray pixels (localized mottling and scarring).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast light-gray mottling concentrated in a dense cluster on the upper-lateral region of the right lobe, featuring ring-like dark centers; dispersed, smaller circular light-gray spots scattered across the upper-inner region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations (valleys < 5 pixels deep) along the visible upper boundary of both lobes, punctuated by irregular peaks towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following a symmetrical upward trajectory from the central axis toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel groups on the right lobe (distal-medial) and a sparser constellation of similar smaller circular marks on the left lobe (medial).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct, roughly parallel horizontal-diagonal light-gray linear pixel disruptions located on the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, calcified high-intensity pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
